import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        StringBuilder resultStr = new StringBuilder();
        boolean usedAt = false;
        int posIdx = 0;
        while (posIdx < s.length()) {
            if (posIdx != 0 && posIdx + 3 <= s.length() && s.substring(posIdx, posIdx + 3).equals("dot")) {
                resultStr.append('.');
                posIdx += 2;
            } else if (posIdx != 0 && posIdx + 2 <= s.length() && !usedAt && s.substring(posIdx, posIdx + 2).equals("at")) {
                resultStr.append('@');
                usedAt = true;
                posIdx += 1;
            } else {
                resultStr.append(s.charAt(posIdx));
            }
            posIdx += 1;
        }
        System.out.println(resultStr.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
